description: This source file defines the class UserMigrationStatsDetail, which represents details of individual migration results related to user data in the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties for migration type, user identification, message, and optional event migration details, along with methods for construction, string representation, and setting event migration details.

classes.name: UserMigrationStatsDetail
classes.description: Represents details of a single migration statistic related to a user, including type, user info, message, and optional event migration details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a UserMigrationStatsDetail object with specified type, optional user ID, user name, and message.

methods.name: setEventMigrationDetail
methods.description: Sets the event migration details for this migration detail object.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the migration detail, including user info, type, message, and event details.
